about_the_game:
Story

"If you kill the impostors, you can become real —"

This is the trash can where the failed fragments of fairy tales are cast away.

The failures have a name for themselves, "Alters", and fight to become real.

When you awaken, you encounter three false Alices:

the Destroyer, the Hunter, and the Sorcerer.

Each possesses her own unique personality, and must kill the others.

"Only one can become the true Alice."

To become the one true Alice, the failures continue their ritual of slaughter within this trash can world.

Suddenly, an anomaly slips in. You.

You begin to rewrite the tale,

creating a story where death does not reign.

In a world built upon mutual killing, this is the greatest taboo—

and the only hope.

Who will you save, who will you choose?

Your decisions will shape the ending of this tale.

Characters

Destroyer Alice (CV: Aoi Yūki)

A failed Alice. Dressed in red, wielding a single blade, she acts on impulse and instinct.

Reckless and one to choose actions over words, but deeply loyal and extremely attached to her Teacher (you).

Sometimes her dangerous possessiveness surfaces, but praise her once and her mood instantly softens. A pure, straightforward Alice.

Hunter Alice (CV: Chiwa Saitō)

A failed Alice. A cool-headed archer skilled in long-range attacks, reconnaissance, and assassination.

Sharp-tongued and aloof, yet unexpectedly caring. She recognizes you as her strategist and cooperates accordingly.

Bad at hiding her embarrassment, the times she lets the facade slip tend to leave the strongest impression.

Sorcerer Alice (CV: Misato Fukuen)

A failed Alice. A white-hatted sorcerer who wields magic.

Timid and clumsy, yet never one to hesitate during the decisive moment.

She wishes more than anyone to place her trust in you.

Through continuous small acts of courage, she's an Alice of quiet kindness who can turn the tide creating great victories.

Alter Alice (CV: Inori Minase)

A failed Alice. The strongest foe and closest to becoming the "real" one.

She possesses overwhelming power. Yet strangely enough, before you she sometimes shows kindness or hesitation.

She embodies both the desire to become the true Alice and the very laws of this world, making her an unavoidable rival.

Teacher (You)

You, the protagonist.

Awakening without memories, you embark on a journey alongside the Alices.

■Game Introduction

・Game Type: This is a single player visual novel where you make decisions that cause a change in the story leading to different endings based on those choices.

・Gameplay: At key points in the story you will be given choices to make. Your choices will affect the characters' survival, relations and ending.

・Quality of life features: Skipping read text, backlog, auto mode and a skip feature have been added

・Save/Load Feature: You're able to save and load the game at any point

・Gallery: You'll be able to view the in-game art stills at your leisure through this feature

content_descriptors.notes:
・Fantasy / Mild Violence
This work features female characters in their teens and twenties inspired by fairy tales, referred to throughout the story as “Alters” or “Failures.” Within the narrative, these fairy-tale-inspired characters engage in battles using weapons and magic. All depictions are fictional, with no discriminatory intent toward any real-world groups or minorities. While the story draws upon motifs from existing fairy tales, it does not seek to plagiarize or misappropriate original works or expressions.

・Blood / Acts of Violence / Bodily Injury / Corpses / Violent Depictions / Killing / Detailed Death Depictions / Representations of Violence / Horror / Mild Profanity
The story includes portrayals of blood, injuries, death, and corpses, as well as scenes intended to evoke fear and instances of mild profanity. These elements are primarily presented through text and indirect visual references. The work does not employ sudden “jump scare” techniques.

Who will become the real Alice? This is a visual novel where your decisions, will change the ending of the story.
